[Accepted Concepts](https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms?domain=Episode&page=1&pageSize=15&query=)

episode.episode_start_date.guidance: The date when the Episode beings.
episode.episode_start_date.conventions: Please see [article] for how to define an Episode start date.

episode.episode_start_datetime.guidance: The date and time when the Episode begins.

episode.episode_end_date.guidance: The date when the instance of the Episode is considered to have ended.
episode.episode_end_date.conventions: Please see [article] for how to define an Episode end date.

episode.episode_end_datetime.guidance: The date when the instance of the Episode is considered to have ended.

episode.episode_parent_id.guidance: Use this field to find the Episode that subsumes the given Episode record. This is used in the case that an Episode are nested into each other.
episode.episode_parent_id.conventions: If there are multiple nested levels to how Episodes are represented, the EPISODE_PARENT_ID can be used to record this relationship.

episode.episode_number.guidance: For sequences of episodes, this is used to indicate the order the episodes occurred. For example, lines of treatment could be indicated here.
episode.episode_number.conventions: Please see [article] for the details of how to count episodes.

episode.episode_object_concept_id.guidance: A Standard Concept representing the disease phase, outcome, or other abstraction of which the episode consists.  For example, if the EPISODE_CONCEPT_ID is [treatment regimen](https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms/32531) then the EPISODE_OBJECT_CONCEPT_ID should contain the chemotherapy regimen concept, like [Afatinib monotherapy](https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms/35804392).
episode.episode_object_concept_id.conventions: Episode entries from the 'Disease Episode' concept class should have an episode_object_concept_id that comes from the Condition domain.  Episode entries from the 'Treatment Episode' concept class should have an episode_object_concept_id that scome from the 'Procedure' domain or 'Regimen' concept class.

episode.episode_type_concept_id.guidance: This field can be used to determine the provenance of the Episode record, as in whether the episode was from an EHR system, insurance claim, registry, or other sources.
episode.episode_type_concept_id.conventions: Choose the EPISODE_TYPE_CONCEPT_ID that best represents the provenance of the record. [Accepted Concepts](https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms?domain=Type+Concept&standardConcept=Standard&page=1&pageSize=15&query=). A more detailed explanation of each Type Concept can be found on the [vocabulary wiki](https://github.com/OHDSI/Vocabulary-v5.0/wiki/Vocab.-TYPE_CONCEPT).

episode.episode_source_value.guidance: The source code for the Episode as it appears in the source data. This code is mapped to a Standard Condition Concept in the Standardized Vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

episode.episode_source_concept_id.guidance: A foreign key to a Episode Concept that refers to the code used in the source.
episode.episode_source_concept_id.conventions: Given that the Episodes are user-defined it is unlikely that there will be a Source Concept available. If that is the case then set this field to zero.

episode_event.episode_id.guidance: Use this field to link the EPISODE_EVENT record to its EPISODE.
episode_event.episode_id.conventions: Put the EPISODE_ID that subsumes the EPISODE_EVENT record here.

episode_event.event_id.guidance: This field is the primary key of the linked record in the database. For example, if the Episode Event is a Condition Occurrence, then the CONDITION_OCCURRENCE_ID of the linked record goes in this field.
episode_event.event_id.conventions: Put the primary key of the linked record here.

episode_event.episode_event_field_concep.guidance: This field is the CONCEPT_ID that identifies which table the primary key of the linked record came from.
episode_event.episode_event_field_concep.conventions: Put the CONCEPT_ID that identifies which table and field the EVENT_ID came from. [Accepted Concepts](https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms?vocabulary=CDM&conceptClass=Field&page=1&pageSize=15&query=)

metadata.metadata_id.guidance: The unique key given to a Metadata record.

metadata.value_as_number.guidance: This is the numerical value of the result of the Metadata, if applicable and available. It is not expected that all Metadata will have numeric results, rather, this field is here to house values should they exist.

cdm_source.cdm_source_name.guidance: The name of the CDM instance.

cdm_source.cdm_source_abbreviation.guidance: The abbreviation of the CDM instance.

cdm_source.cdm_holder.guidance: The holder of the CDM instance.

cdm_source.source_description.guidance: The description of the CDM instance.

cdm_source.source_documentation_referenc.guidance: Refers to a publication or web resource describing the source data, e.g. a data dictionary.

cdm_source.cdm_etl_reference.guidance: Version of the ETL script used. e.g. link to the Git release

cdm_source.source_release_date.guidance: The date the data was extracted from the source system. In some systems that is the same as the date the ETL was run. Typically the latest even date in the source is on the source_release_date.

cdm_source.cdm_release_date.guidance: The date the ETL script was completed. Typically this is after the source_release_date.

cdm_source.cdm_version.guidance: Version of the OMOP CDM used as string. e.g. v5.4

cdm_source.cdm_version_concept_id.guidance: The Concept Id representing the version of the CDM.
cdm_source.cdm_version_concept_id.conventions: You can find all concepts that represent the CDM versions using the query: `SELECT * FROM CONCEPT WHERE   VOCABULARY_ID = 'CDM' AND CONCEPT_CLASS = 'CDM'`

cdm_source.vocabulary_version.guidance: Version of the OMOP standardised vocabularies loaded
cdm_source.vocabulary_version.conventions: You can find the version of your Vocabulary using the query: `SELECT vocabulary_version from vocabulary  where vocabulary_id = 'None'`

concept.concept_id.guidance: A unique identifier for each Concept across all domains.

concept.concept_name.guidance: An unambiguous, meaningful and descriptive name for the Concept.

concept.domain_id.guidance: A foreign key to the [DOMAIN](https://ohdsi.github.io/CommonDataModel/cdm54.html#domain) table the Concept belongs to.

concept.vocabulary_id.guidance:
A foreign key to the [VOCABULARY](https://ohdsi.github.io/CommonDataModel/cdm54.html#vocabulary)
table indicating from which source the
Concept has been adapted.

concept.concept_class_id.guidance:
The attribute or concept class of the
Concept. Examples are 'Clinical Drug',
'Ingredient', 'Clinical Finding' etc.

concept.standard_concept.guidance:
This flag determines where a Concept is
a Standard Concept, i.e. is used in the
data, a Classification Concept, or a
non-standard Source Concept. The
allowable values are 'S' (Standard
Concept) and 'C' (Classification
Concept), otherwise the content is NULL.

concept.concept_code.guidance:
The concept code represents the identifier
of the Concept in the source vocabulary,
such as SNOMED-CT concept IDs,
RxNorm RXCUIs etc. Note that concept
codes are not unique across vocabularies.

concept.valid_start_date.guidance:
The date when the Concept was first
recorded. The default value is
1-Jan-1970, meaning, the Concept has no
(known) date of inception.

concept.valid_end_date.guidance:
The date when the Concept became
invalid because it was deleted or
superseded (updated) by a new concept.
The default value is 31-Dec-2099,
meaning, the Concept is valid until it
becomes deprecated.

concept.invalid_reason.guidance:
Reason the Concept was invalidated.
Possible values are D (deleted), U
(replaced with an update) or NULL when
valid_end_date has the default value.

vocabulary.vocabulary_id.guidance:
A unique identifier for each Vocabulary, such
as ICD9CM, SNOMED, Visit.

vocabulary.vocabulary_name.guidance:
The name describing the vocabulary, for
example, International Classification of
Diseases, Ninth Revision, Clinical
Modification, Volume 1 and 2 (NCHS) etc.

vocabulary.vocabulary_reference.guidance:
External reference to documentation or
available download of the about the
vocabulary.

vocabulary.vocabulary_version.guidance:
Version of the Vocabulary as indicated in
the source.

vocabulary.vocabulary_concept_id.guidance: A Concept that represents the Vocabulary the VOCABULARY record belongs to.

domain.domain_id.guidance: A unique key for each domain.

domain.domain_name.guidance:
The name describing the Domain, e.g.
Condition, Procedure, Measurement
etc.

domain.domain_concept_id.guidance: A Concept representing the Domain Concept the DOMAIN record belongs to.

concept_class.concept_class_id.guidance: A unique key for each class.

concept_class.concept_class_name.guidance:
The name describing the Concept Class, e.g.
Clinical Finding, Ingredient, etc.

concept_class.concept_class_concept_id.guidance: A Concept that represents the Concept Class.

concept_relationship.relationship_id.guidance: The relationship between CONCEPT_ID_1 and CONCEPT_ID_2. Please see the [Vocabulary Conventions](https://ohdsi.github.io/CommonDataModel/dataModelConventions.html#concept_relationships). for more information.

concept_relationship.valid_start_date.guidance: The date when the relationship is first recorded.

concept_relationship.valid_end_date.guidance: The date when the relationship is invalidated.

concept_relationship.invalid_reason.guidance: Reason the relationship was invalidated. Possible values are 'D' (deleted), 'U' (updated) or NULL.

relationship.relationship_id.guidance:
The type of relationship captured by the
relationship record.

relationship.is_hierarchical.guidance:
Defines whether a relationship defines
concepts into classes or hierarchies. Values
are 1 for hierarchical relationship or 0 if not.

relationship.defines_ancestry.guidance:
Defines whether a hierarchical relationship
contributes to the concept_ancestor table.
These are subsets of the hierarchical
relationships. Valid values are 1 or 0.

relationship.reverse_relationship_id.guidance:
The identifier for the relationship used to
define the reverse relationship between two
concepts.

relationship.relationship_concept_id.guidance:
A foreign key that refers to an identifier in
the [CONCEPT](https://ohdsi.github.io/CommonDataModel/cdm54.html#concept) table for the unique
relationship concept.

concept_ancestor.ancestor_concept_id.guidance:
The Concept Id for the higher-level concept
that forms the ancestor in the relationship.

concept_ancestor.descendant_concept_id.guidance:
The Concept Id for the lower-level concept
that forms the descendant in the
relationship.

concept_ancestor.min_levels_of_separatio.guidance:
The minimum separation in number of
levels of hierarchy between ancestor and
descendant concepts. This is an attribute
that is used to simplify hierarchic analysis.

concept_ancestor.max_levels_of_separatio.guidance:
The maximum separation in number of
levels of hierarchy between ancestor and
descendant concepts. This is an attribute
that is used to simplify hierarchic analysis.

source_to_concept_map.source_code.guidance:
The source code being translated
into a Standard Concept.

source_to_concept_map.source_concept_id.guidance:
A foreign key to the Source
Concept that is being translated
into a Standard Concept.
source_to_concept_map.source_concept_id.conventions: This is either 0 or should be a number above 2 billion, which are the Concepts reserved for site-specific codes and mappings.

source_to_concept_map.source_vocabulary_.guidance:
A foreign key to the
VOCABULARY table defining the
vocabulary of the source code that
is being translated to a Standard
Concept.

source_to_concept_map.source_code_descri.guidance:
An optional description for the
source code. This is included as a
convenience to compare the
description of the source code to
the name of the concept.

source_to_concept_map.target_concept_id.guidance:
The target Concept
to which the source code is being
mapped.

source_to_concept_map.target_vocabulary_.guidance: The Vocabulary of the target Concept.

source_to_concept_map.valid_start_date.guidance:
The date when the mapping
instance was first recorded.

source_to_concept_map.valid_end_date.guidance:
The date when the mapping
instance became invalid because it
was deleted or superseded
(updated) by a new relationship.
Default value is 31-Dec-2099.

source_to_concept_map.invalid_reason.guidance: Reason the mapping instance was invalidated. Possible values are D (deleted), U (replaced with an update) or NULL when valid_end_date has the default value.

drug_strength.drug_concept_id.guidance: The Concept representing the Branded Drug or Clinical Drug Product.

drug_strength.ingredient_concept_id.guidance: The Concept representing the active ingredient contained within the drug product.
drug_strength.ingredient_concept_id.conventions: Combination Drugs will have more than one record in this table, one for each active Ingredient.

drug_strength.amount_value.guidance: The numeric value or the amount of active ingredient contained within the drug product.

drug_strength.amount_unit_concept_id.guidance: The Concept representing the Unit of measure for the amount of active ingredient contained within the drug product.

drug_strength.numerator_value.guidance: The concentration of the active ingredient contained within the drug product.

drug_strength.numerator_unit_concept_id.guidance: The Concept representing the Unit of measure for the concentration of active ingredient.

drug_strength.denominator_value.guidance: The amount of total liquid (or other divisible product, such as ointment, gel, spray, etc.).

drug_strength.denominator_unit_concept_i.guidance: The Concept representing the denominator unit for the concentration of active ingredient.

drug_strength.box_size.guidance: The number of units of Clinical Branded Drug or Quantified Clinical or Branded Drug contained in a box as dispensed to the patient.

drug_strength.valid_start_date.guidance:
The date when the Concept was first
recorded. The default value is
1-Jan-1970.

drug_strength.valid_end_date.guidance: The date when then Concept became invalid.

drug_strength.invalid_reason.guidance: Reason the concept was invalidated. Possible values are D (deleted), U (replaced with an update) or NULL when valid_end_date has the default value.

cohort_definition.cohort_definition_id.guidance: This is the identifier given to the cohort, usually by the ATLAS application

cohort_definition.cohort_definition_name.guidance: A short description of the cohort

cohort_definition.cohort_definition_desc.guidance: A complete description of the cohort.

cohort_definition.definition_type_concep.guidance: Type defining what kind of Cohort Definition the record represents and how the syntax may be executed.

cohort_definition.cohort_definition_synt.guidance: Syntax or code to operationalize the Cohort Definition.

cohort_definition.subject_concept_id.guidance: This field contains a Concept that represents the domain of the subjects that are members of the cohort (e.g., Person, Provider, Visit).

cohort_definition.cohort_initiation_date.guidance: A date to indicate when the Cohort was initiated in the COHORT table.
